source: USGS King City South SIM3486 sheet 2

spatial20m.normalizationReference: Maximum depth among publisher-designated QA points; not a claim about the full-lake maximum.

limitations: QA points occupy 21 cells and do not cover the entire lake.
Corrections were explicitly prepared from source contours and printed coordinates; no QA depth was used to build the record.
Normalized diagnostic uses maximum QA depth, not the full-lake maximum.
Calibration controls share one source-coordinate fit; zero fit residual is not independent geographic validation.

warnings: Dismiss warning: A lake has incomplete depth chart coverage. Uncovered cells use existing terrain, modeled depths, or estimates near surveyed shores; cells without enough information remain at the waterline.
Some lake floors come from a traced depth chart. They are only as accurate as the chart and its tracing.
